inspection_history: All V1-V4 pre-holdout evidence inspected; DEVELOPMENT only. V4 hybrid is not promoted or selected post hoc.

features.domain_note: Timeframe/horizon are constant validated domain fields, not fabricated varying predictors.
features.alignment: Exact last closed instrument/BTC/ETH candle equals decision time. Missing/stale/future context fails closed.

state_support: TARGET_PROFIT/TARGET_LOSS split is deterministic from decision-time room minus frozen cost. Latent classifier states TARGET,STOP,TIMEOUT_PROFIT,TIMEOUT_LOSS. When room<=cost, profitable timeout is structurally impossible and its latent logit is -infinity before softmax. Joint probabilities are constructed from the one normalized latent vector; no post-hoc probability clipping. No STOP_PROFIT state.
label_support_evidence: Frozen development cache: TARGET_LOSS=37, TARGET_PROFIT=52281, STOP_LOSS=137019, TIMEOUT_PROFIT=37863, TIMEOUT_LOSS=23402; no STOP_PROFIT. Terminal net-R matches room-cost / -1-cost; timeout net-R within [-1-cost,room-cost]. Checked before model evaluation.

classifier.recency: 2^(-(training_cutoff-decision_time)/(half_life_days*86400000)), normalized to mean 1; timestamps only. Transform fitting unweighted and training-only.

sampling: Identical V4 every-twelfth canonical-row sample and identical outer test indices; no family/instrument exclusion.
folds: Same six equal chronological development windows: seed 0, outer 1..5. Inner three equal prefix windows: seed 0, validation 1,2. All training label horizons must end strictly before cutoff; all validation horizons mature before inner-end.
selection: Lowest pooled inner binary Brier derived from the joint vector selects variant within architecture and architecture; ties follow registry order. Equivalent C_NONE reuses A_001 scores/fits. No outer selection. Final variant is last outer prefix's inner choice, then refit all matured pre-holdout development.

conditional_distribution.representation: 101 equiprobable conditional atoms per joint state; expected payoff and marginal quantiles derive from this same mixture. TARGET/STOP net atoms deterministic frozen geometry/cost. TIMEOUT magnitude mean histogram trees plus training-only empirical residual-ratio atoms, bounded to causal terminal net support. MFE/MAE per-state nonnegative histogram means with training-only residual-ratio atoms. Small states (<400) use empirical constant distribution; retained, not removed.
conditional_distribution.conditional_sign: Positive states nonnegative magnitude; loss states nonpositive magnitude. Bounds are generative outcome support, not probability clipping.
conditional_distribution.time: 48-bin state-conditional empirical event-time distribution with Dirichlet 0.5/bin smoothing, fit from relevant first-touch label only. TIMEOUT is administrative horizon censoring at 48, not an observed target/stop event. Joint state/time mass is p(state)*p(time|state).
conditional_distribution.path_support: Common equiprobable atom index couples net payoff/MFE/MAE. MFE includes positive gross terminal payoff; MAE includes negative gross terminal payoff. TARGET MFE>=known room and STOP MAE>=1. These causal generative bounds are engineering correctness, not outer-tuned probability clipping.
conditional_distribution.time_index_units: Frozen zero-based first-touch index is converted to elapsed support 1..48; timeout censoring at 48. Canonical first-touch quantiles retain zero-based label units.
